title: encrypt_aes_cbc key/iv size assertions use expect() in closure passed as FnOnce
description: In encrypt(), the closure passed to encrypt_aes_cbc uses .expect() for the key and IV try_from conversions. These panics are guaranteed not to fire because key_len is 16 or 32 (matching the buffer generated by getrandom) and iv is always [0u8;16]. However, the expect is inside an opaque closure — a reader must trace the buffer size through two call sites to confirm safety. Using a debug_assert! and constructing the Key/Iv directly from the fixed-size arrays would make the invariant local and obvious.
